units.source_text: 这些话，太吉郎以前来的时候也听说过，但现在听了还是点头表示赞同。

en.t: Taikichiro had heard these things when he came before, but hearing them now, he still nodded in agreement.

units.source_text: 即使是模仿中国的，他也说：“古代真了不起啊……恐怕是千年前的了吧。”

en.t: Even if it was modeled on China, he said, "Ancient times really were remarkable... it must be from a thousand years ago, I suppose."
